compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a list of daily devotional messages titled "Today's Word." Each entry includes a date, a title, and a corresponding Bible verse reference. The entries are organized in descending order by date, starting from February 5th and going back to January 29th. The titles and Bible verses are as follows:

- February 5: "Receive the Overflow" (Psalm 66:12, NIV)
- February 4: "What If They Don't Believe?" (Romans 3:3, KJV)
- February 3: "Say So" (Psalm 107:2, AMPC)
- February 2: "Whatever You Do Will Prosper" (Psalm 1:3, NIV)
- February 1: "Put it into Action" (Philemon 1:6, NLT)
- January 31: "Speak to Your Mountains" (Matthew 21:21, NKJV)
- January 30: "Follow the Leader
